_meta.independence_statement: Every expected answer herein is independently derived from the pinned contracts and stated logic; no legacy system output was consulted and no ephemeris is involved. These are state-based expectations.
_meta.chart_id_rule: All chart ids are synthetic wp2-synth-* ids. No real chart id appears anywhere in this file.
_meta.completeness_state_note: Six F06 completeness states; an honest state is always stored, never a 0.0 score or an empty list standing in for one (plan §4.6, §N.7 item 6).

case_07_negative_sensitive_degree_zero_t.description: Negative-result sensitive-degree checks must produce ZERO targets: the negative predicates are removed at the resonance layer (N-12, WP3c R-1), never carried as targets and never stored as 'inapplicable'.

expected.note: All four negative predicates (not_gandanta, mrityu_bhaga=not_fired, not_pushkara, kartari=none) are dropped at the resonance build (R-1). There is no row left to carry a state -- the honest outcome is the ABSENCE of the row, not a row marked negative. Positive predicates (papa_kartari, shubha_kartari, pushkara) still resolve to the subject graha's own degree and merge into that graha's independence_group.

case_08_cusp_placeholder_arudha.description: Arudha target whose stored longitude_sidereal is exactly 30*(sign-1) = 270.0000 (a cusp placeholder, F-20): no point contact may EVER be generated against 270.0000; the target resolves as the sign-level interval only.

expected.test_failure_condition: Any degree-level contact (conjunction/drishti/return/kakshya) with target_longitude_deg = 270.0 is a failure: the cited fact does not actually carry that degree. A degree-level arudha is M-5/M-6, out of scope for this run.

case_09_dangling_yoga_id.description: Resonance target references yoga id 'ardhachandra' with NO live ga_yoga_firings row: the resolution state 'unavailable' must be recorded (R-6), never a silent skip and never an invented degree.
case_09_dangling_yoga_id.derivation: hand-specified per WP1_CONTRACTS.md §2.2 item 7 + F-21 (mirrors the live ardhachandra/chatra dangling case)

unresolved.reason: no ga_yoga_firings row with fired=true for this yoga id

expected.silence_is_failure: No emitted row AND no recorded state, or a fabricated longitude, is a test failure.

case_10_missing_overlay.description: Interval where the Vedha/Moorti overlay is absent (beyond its coverage, e.g. +/-60 d around computed instants or +400 d style extension limits): quality_gates must be reported unavailable, NEVER defaulted to 1.0; the coverage manifest records unavailable_inputs.
case_10_missing_overlay.derivation: hand-specified per WP1_CONTRACTS.md §4 (unavailable_inputs) + §2.1 (overlay beyond horizon -> unavailable)

expected.lambda_scoring_effect: WP2 oracle contract: with quality_gates unavailable the scored lambda for the interval is NOT computable as a number; the projection must emit the honest unavailable state. quality_gates=1.0-by-default would certify un-vetted intervals as fully gated -- a test failure (F06/§N.7 item 6).

case_11_solver_exception.description: A primitive that raises mid-evaluation: the failure must propagate as an explicit failure state on the row (F-08 / H-2) -- NEVER surface as a 0.0 score that a >= threshold then certifies as 'active'.
case_11_solver_exception.derivation: hand-specified per plan §8.1 H-2 + §4.2 (near_station_unresolved propagation) + F-08

inputs.behavior: raises RuntimeError('kakshya boundary row missing for chart wp2-synth-...011') mid-evaluation of one (body, target) row; all other rows evaluate normally

expected_failure_representation.pinned: completeness_state='unqualified' on the failed row, with failure_detail={'primitive': 'kakshya_cell_crossing', 'error_class': 'RuntimeError', 'message': 'kakshya boundary row missing', 'row_identity': '<chart_id, body, target_ref>'}; the EvaluationFailure is additionally available as a raised exception to the caller (plan §4.2: near_station_unresolved propagates completeness_state='unqualified' into the row, never a silent boolean). The other rows in the same build are unaffected.
expected_failure_representation.test_failure_condition: Any path where the raised exception is swallowed and the row scores 0.0 (which an >= active_threshold comparison would then certify 'inactive-but-evaluated', or worse 'active' after clamping) is the exact F-08 defect and fails this fixture.
